description: This file defines an abstract generic class 'ContentPartDisplayDriver<TPart>' that provides display and editing logic for content parts within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It manages shape generation, alternates, and display modes for content parts, facilitating flexible rendering of content items.

classes.name: ContentPartDisplayDriver<TPart>
classes.description: An abstract class providing display and editor shape generation for content parts, supporting customization based on shape type, display mode, and content stereotypes.

methods.name: Factory
methods.description: Creates a shape result for a content part, adding alternates and differentiators based on content type, part, and display mode.

methods.name: BuildDisplayAsync
methods.description: Builds the display shape asynchronously for a content part.

methods.name: BuildEditorAsync
methods.description: Builds the editor shape asynchronously for a content part.

methods.name: UpdateEditorAsync
methods.description: Updates the editor shape asynchronously and applies changes to the content item.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Virtual method to generate display shape; can be overridden.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Virtual method to generate display shape synchronously; can be overridden.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Virtual method to generate edit shape; can be overridden.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Virtual method to generate edit shape synchronously; can be overridden.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Virtual method to handle update logic; can be overridden.

methods.name: GetEditorShapeType
methods.description: Constructs the shape type for editor shapes based on context.

methods.name: GetDisplayShapeType
methods.description: Constructs the shape type for display shapes based on context.

methods.name: BuildPrefix
methods.description: Creates a temporary prefix for form fields, restoring the original after use.
